{{Quote|Per your orders, a brigade from the 501st has been dispatched to New Plympto to end the fighting there.''"<br />"''Excellent.|Sate Pestage, and Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Dark Times 1" />}}
A '''brigade''' of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was dispatched by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] to put down the local [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|New Plympto resistance]]. The [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] consisted of a [[Vill's regiment|regiment]] under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vill]], and was supported by [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]] and [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tanks]].<ref name="Dark Times 1" />
